in_sanskrit.name: धरन्
in_sanskrit.meaning: to hold, to bear, to sustain, to preserve
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who holds, bears, sustains, preserves. The name is derived from the root word धर् (dhar) which means to hold, sustain or preserve.

in_hindi.name: धरन
in_hindi.meaning: धरना (dharana) - धरतु (dhatu) से स्वरूप रूप के साथ उत्पन्न हुए नाम। यह संध्या के समय प्रसादी शिव के साथ संबोधन करने वाला देवता के नाम है।
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Dharan is derived from the root word धरना (dharana) which means to hold, sustain or preserve, and the suffix न (na) which denotes a male gender. This is the name of the deity who offers oblations to Lord Shiva during the sandhyā (twilight) ritual.

in_tamil.name: தரன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who holds, sustains, and preserves. The name is derived from the root word தர் (tar) which means to hold, sustain or preserve.

in_telugu.name: ధరన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who holds, sustains, and preserves. The name is derived from the root word धर् (dhar) which means to hold, sustain or preserve.

in_marathi.name: Dharan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Dharan means 'Holder' or 'Supporter'. It is a name that signifies strength and stability, evoking images of someone who can be relied upon. In Hindu mythology, Dharma, the Hindu god of morality and righteousness, is often depicted as holding the universe on his shoulders, symbolizing the importance of upholding values and maintaining balance.
